properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Audit Logs
properties.query:
let AuthEventNames   = dynamic(['FederatedLoginRequest', 'InteractiveLogin', 'AuthenticationUser',
                                'ReceiveSamlSpSsoResonse', 'ReceiveSamlSpSsoResponse',
                                'SentSamlIdpSsoResonse', 'SentSamlIdpSsoResponse',
                                'FactorMfa', 'InitiateSSOAuthFactor', 'SuccessAuthentication']);
let parser = (
    disabled:                   bool     = false,
    pack:                       bool     = false
) {
    OCI_LogsV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    // -- Audit events only (exclude auth events and flow log rows)
    | where isnotempty(data_eventName_s)
    | where data_eventName_s !in (AuthEventNames)
    | where isempty(data_sourceAddress_s)
    // -- Parse nested JSON
    | extend _data = parse_json(data)
    // -- Result
    | extend ResponseStatus = tostring(_data.response.status)
    | extend
        EventResult = case(
            ResponseStatus == '200', 'Success',
            ResponseStatus in ('400', '401', '403', '404', '500'), 'Failure',
            isempty(ResponseStatus), 'NA',
            'NA'),
        EventResultDetails = case(
            ResponseStatus == '401', 'Unauthorised',
            ResponseStatus == '403', 'Forbidden',
            ResponseStatus == '404', 'Not found',
            '')
    // -- Operation & EventType
    | extend Operation = data_eventName_s
    | extend _instanceActionType = tostring(_data.additionalDetails.instanceActionType)
    | extend EventType = case(
        // InstanceAction: map sub-type using additionalDetails.instanceActionType (lowercase)
        Operation == 'InstanceAction' and _instanceActionType =~ 'start',                                                   'Start',
        Operation == 'InstanceAction' and (_instanceActionType =~ 'stop' or _instanceActionType =~ 'softstop'),             'Stop',
        Operation == 'InstanceAction' and _instanceActionType =~ 'terminate',                                               'Delete',
        Operation == 'InstanceAction',                                                                                      'Execute',  // softreset, reset, or unknown
        // Read operations
        Operation startswith 'List'        or
        Operation startswith 'Get'         or
        Operation startswith 'Describe'    or
        Operation startswith 'Summarize'   or
        Operation startswith 'pull'        or  // Container Registry pulls
        Operation startswith 'read'        or  // Container Registry reads
        Operation startswith 'Read'        or
        Operation startswith 'search'      or  // search* / Search*
        Operation startswith 'Search'      or
        Operation startswith 'filter'      or  // filterLogs
        Operation startswith 'Filter'      or
        Operation startswith 'Retrieve'    or
        Operation startswith 'Request'     or
        Operation startswith 'Check'       or  // CheckDataSafeEnable
        Operation startswith 'UserAssessment' or  // UserAssessmentPasswordExpiryDate
        Operation startswith 'Warehouse',      'Read',  // WarehouseWhiteListedInfo
        // Create / provision
        Operation startswith 'Create'      or
        Operation startswith 'Launch'      or
        Operation startswith 'Automatic'   or
        Operation startswith 'Copy'        or  // CopyBootVolumeBackup, CopyVolumeBackup
        Operation startswith 'Schedule'    or  // ScheduledUpgrade, ScheduleVaultDeletion, ScheduleKeyDeletion
        Operation == 'SuccessCreate',          'Create',
        // Delete
        Operation startswith 'Delete'      or
        Operation startswith 'Terminate'   or
        Operation startswith 'Release'     or  // ReleaseCloudShellHost
        Operation == 'SuccessDelete',          'Delete',
        // Enable
        Operation startswith 'Activate'    or
        Operation startswith 'Resume'      or  // ResumeAuditTrail
        Operation == 'enable_process_automation', 'Enable',
        // Disable
        Operation startswith 'Deactivate',     'Disable',  // DeactivateUser, DeactivatedApp
        // Stop
        Operation startswith 'Stop'        or  // StopAuditTrail, StopAutonomousDatabase
        Operation startswith 'stop',           'Stop',     // stopAnalyticsInstance (lowercase)
        // Set / modify (config and membership changes)
        Operation startswith 'Update'      or
        Operation startswith 'Modify'      or
        Operation startswith 'Patch'       or
        Operation startswith 'Attach'      or
        Operation startswith 'Detach'      or
        Operation startswith 'Add'         or  // AddUserToGroup, AddApprole
        Operation startswith 'Remove'      or  // RemoveUserFromGroup, RemoveApprole
        Operation startswith 'Send'        or  // SendVerificationEmail
        Operation startswith 'Sent'        or
        Operation startswith 'StateChange' or  // StateChangeTargetDatabase
        Operation startswith 'change'      or  // changeAnalyticsInstanceNetworkEndpoint (lowercase)
        Operation startswith 'Assign'      or  // AssignCloudShellHost
        Operation startswith 'Replace',        'Set',  // ReplaceManagedappconnectiontester, ReplaceTenantschema
        // Execute / action
        Operation endswith   'Action'      or
        Operation startswith 'generate'    or
        Operation startswith 'Execute'     or
        Operation startswith 'Access'      or  // AccessApp
        Operation startswith 'Initiate'    or  // InitiateSSOAuthFactor
        Operation startswith 'Cancel'      or
        Operation startswith 'job.'        or  // job.failed, job.succeeded
        Operation startswith 'Job'         or  // JobRunning
        Operation startswith 'Calculate'   or  // CalculateAuditVolumeCollected/Available
        Operation startswith 'Audit'       or  // AuditCollectionWarning
        Operation startswith 'Acquire'     or  // AcquireInternalUsage
        Operation == 'InstanceConsoleConnected'        or
        Operation == 'EmailNotificationDeliveryStatus' or
        Operation == 'push_billing_details',               'Execute',
        // Upload (OCI agent data uploads)
        Operation startswith 'Upload',         'Create',
        // Kubernetes / OKE events: verb is the last dot-delimited segment
        Operation endswith '.update' or
        Operation endswith '.patch',           'Set',
        Operation endswith '.create',          'Create',
        Operation endswith '.delete' or
        Operation endswith '.deletecollection', 'Delete',
        'Other')
    // -- Actor
    | extend
        ActorUsername     = data_identity_principalName_s,
        ActorUserId       = data_identity_principalId_s,
        ActorUserIdType   = 'Other',
        ActorUserType     = case(
            data_identity_authType_s == 'fed',      'Regular',  // federated human user
            data_identity_authType_s =~ 'USER',     'Regular',  // human user (case variant)
            data_identity_authType_s == 'natv',     'Regular',  // native IDCS user
            data_identity_authType_s == 'instance', 'Machine',  // instance principal
            data_identity_authType_s == 'resource', 'Machine',  // resource principal
            data_identity_authType_s == 'service',  'Machine',  // OCI service-to-service
            data_identity_authType_s == 'none',     'System',
            ''),
        ActorUsernameType = iff(data_identity_principalName_s contains '@', 'UPN', 'Simple'),
        ActingAppId       = data_identity_callerId_s,
        ActingAppName     = data_identity_callerName_s
    // -- Source IP
    // OCI may return comma-separated IPs (X-Forwarded-For); take the first.
    // 'localhost' is normalised to the loopback address.
    | extend SrcIpAddr = trim(' ', tostring(split(data_identity_ipAddress_s, ',')[0]))
    | extend SrcIpAddr = iff(SrcIpAddr =~ 'localhost', '127.0.0.1', SrcIpAddr)
    | extend Src = SrcIpAddr
    // -- Object (resource being acted upon)
    // data_resourceId_s is the most reliable source (present on ~38% of events).
    // Fall back to request parameters, stateChange, and additionalDetails.
    // Read-only List* operations (e.g. ListInstances) act on a compartment
    // scope rather than a single resource, so fall back to the compartment
    // OCID as the last resort -- always present, and this is a Mandatory field.
    | extend
        Object = coalesce(
            data_response_payload_resourceName_s,
            data_stateChange_current_displayName_s,
            data_additionalDetails_description_s,
            source_s,                                  // Container Registry repo name (e.g. repo/image)
            data_resourceId_s,
            data_request_parameters_instanceId_s,
            data_stateChange_current_id_s,
            data_additionalDetails_id_s,
            data_additionalDetails_volumeId_s,
            tostring(_data.additionalDetails.path),   // Container Registry repo path (pulldockerlayer etc.)
            data_compartmentId_s),                    // List* operations: the compartment being queried
        ObjectId = coalesce(
            data_resourceId_s,
            data_request_parameters_instanceId_s,
            data_stateChange_current_id_s,
            data_additionalDetails_id_s,
            data_additionalDetails_volumeId_s,
            tostring(_data.additionalDetails.path),   // Container Registry repo path (pulldockerlayer etc.)
            data_compartmentId_s),                    // List* operations: the compartment being queried
        ObjectType = case(
            // Cloud infrastructure resources -> 'Cloud'
            Operation contains 'Instance'   or
            Operation contains 'Bucket'     or
            Operation contains 'Namespace'  or
            Operation in ('pulldockerlayer', 'readdockerrepositorymanifest',
                          'getcontainerimage', 'pushcontainerimage') or
            Operation contains 'Volume'     or
            Operation contains 'Image'      or
            Operation contains 'Database'   or
            Operation contains 'Autonomous' or
            Operation contains 'DbSystem'   or
            Operation contains 'DbHome'     or
            Operation contains 'DbNode'     or
            ((Operation startswith 'List' or Operation startswith 'Get' or
              Operation startswith 'Create' or Operation startswith 'Update' or
              Operation startswith 'Delete') and Operation contains 'Db') or
            Operation contains 'Backup'     or
            Operation contains 'Compartment' or
            Operation contains 'Tenancy'    or
            Operation contains 'Tenant'     or
            Operation contains 'Vnic'       or
            Operation contains 'Subnet'     or
            Operation contains 'Vcn',           'Cloud',
            // Policy, config and metadata -> 'Policy'
            Operation contains 'Tag',            'Policy',
            // Everything else -> 'Other'
            'Other')
    // -- Request details
    // User-Agent is stored as a single-element JSON array by OCI.
    | extend
        TargetUrl     = coalesce(data_request_path_s, tostring(_data.request.path)),
        HttpUserAgent = coalesce(
            tostring(parse_json(data_request_headers_User_Agent_s)[0]),
            tostring(_data.request.headers['User-Agent']))
    // -- Additional fields (source-specific, no ASIM column equivalent)
    // Only populated when pack=true; defaults to dynamic({}) (empty dictionary).
    | extend AdditionalFields = iff(
        pack,
        bag_pack(
            'CompartmentName',    data_compartmentName_s,               // human-readable compartment name
            'AvailabilityDomain', data_availabilityDomain_s,            // AZ where action occurred
            'HttpMethod',         data_action_s,                         // raw HTTP verb (GET/PUT/...)
            'EventGroupingId',    data_eventGroupingId_s,                // correlates related events
            'InstanceShape',      data_additionalDetails_shape_s,        // VM shape / SKU
            'LifecycleState',     data_additionalDetails_lifeCycleState_s, // resource state at event time
            'ResourceType',       data_additionalDetails_type_s,         // fine-grained resource type
            'HomeRegion',         data_additionalDetails_homeRegionKey_s, // resource home region
            'ImageId',            data_additionalDetails_imageId_s,      // compute image OCID
            'Namespace',          data_additionalDetails_namespace_s,    // OCI object-storage namespace
            'StateChange', bag_pack(
                'LifecycleState',   data_stateChange_current_lifecycleState_s,   // state after mutation
                'CompartmentId',    data_stateChange_current_compartmentId_s,    // detects cross-compartment moves
                'IsEnabled',        data_stateChange_current_isEnabled_b,        // enable/disable state after change
                'LifecycleDetails', data_stateChange_current_lifecycleDetails_s, // extra context alongside lifecycle state
                'InstanceId',       data_stateChange_current_instanceId_s,       // instance OCID in stateChange context
                'UserId',           data_stateChange_current_userId_s,           // user OCID affected by the change
                'UserName',         data_stateChange_current_userName_s,         // username affected by the change
                'KeyId',            data_stateChange_current_keyId_s,            // KMS key involved (vault events)
                'LogGroupId',       data_stateChange_current_logGroupId_s,       // log group (logging config changes)
                'LogType',          data_stateChange_current_logType_s,          // log type (logging config changes)
                'TenancyId',        data_stateChange_current_tenancyId_s         // tenancy-level change context
            ),
            'XForwardedFor',      data_request_headers_X_Forwarded_For_s,       // full proxy IP chain
            'ConsoleSessionId',   data_identity_consoleSessionId_s,              // actor's console session
            'WorkRequestId',      data_response_headers_opc_work_request_id_s,  // async work-request ID
            'LayerDigest',        tostring(_data.additionalDetails.digest),      // Container Registry layer SHA256 digest
            'TenantOcid',         oracle_tenantid_s                              // OCI tenancy OCID the audit event occurred in
        ),
        dynamic({})
    )
    // -- Event metadata
    | extend
        EventCount          = int(1),
        EventStartTime      = TimeGenerated,
        EventEndTime        = TimeGenerated,
        EventSchema         = 'AuditEvent',
        EventSchemaVersion  = '1.0.0',
        EventVendor         = 'Oracle',
        EventProduct        = 'OCI',
        EventOriginalType   = data_eventName_s,
        EventOriginalUid    = coalesce(data_request_id_s, tostring(_data.request.id)),
        EventUid            = coalesce(data_request_id_s, tostring(_data.request.id)),
        EventSeverity       = case(
            EventResult == 'Failure' and ResponseStatus == '401', 'Medium',
            EventResult == 'Failure' and ResponseStatus == '403', 'Medium',
            EventResult == 'Failure', 'Low',
            'Informational'),
        DvcScopeId          = oracle_compartmentid_s,
        Dvc                 = 'OCI'
    // -- Project ASIM schema columns only
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        EventCount,
        EventStartTime,
        EventEndTime,
        EventType,
        EventSchema,
        EventSchemaVersion,
        EventVendor,
        EventProduct,
        EventOriginalType,
        EventOriginalUid,
        EventUid,
        EventResult,
        EventResultDetails,
        EventSeverity,
        Operation,
        TargetUrl,
        HttpUserAgent,
        ActorUsername,
        ActorUsernameType,
        ActorUserId,
        ActorUserIdType,
        ActorUserType,
        ActingAppId,
        ActingAppName,
        SrcIpAddr,
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        Src,
        Object,
        ObjectId,
        ObjectType,
        Dvc,
        DvcScopeId,
        AdditionalFields,
        User = ActorUsername,
        Type
};
parser(
    disabled = disabled,
    pack     = pack
)
